productScope: QH-2 XLSX formula and lineage only

contract.mapping: each source-backed calculation may bind one exact outputTarget(sheetId,cell) and 1..64 exact sourceCellRefs
contract.missingMapping: runtime structural observation is unknown and the lane remains unmeasured
contract.formulaPresence: the exact output target must be a formula cell, not a displayed hardcoded value
contract.lineage: bounded same-workbook A1 precedent ranges must cover every contracted source cell
contract.cachedResult: the target cache must exist and be error-free independently of the workbook-wide formula error maximum
contract.recalculation: qualified engine receipt is absent and remains explicitly unmeasured
